community_signals_group_matches_type.name: community_signals_group_matches_type
community_signals_group_matches_type.value: (type IN ('CONFIRM', 'DISPUTE') AND signal_group = 'validity') OR (type IN ('STILL_HAPPENING', 'NO_LONGER_HAPPENING', 'NOT_SURE') AND signal_group = 'current_state')

event_state_transitions_from_valid.name: event_state_transitions_from_valid
event_state_transitions_from_valid.value: from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('UNVERIFIED', 'DEVELOPING', 'LIKELY', 'VERIFIED', 'CONFLICTING', 'STALE', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')

event_timeline_from_valid.name: event_timeline_from_valid
event_timeline_from_valid.value: from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('UNVERIFIED', 'DEVELOPING', 'LIKELY', 'VERIFIED', 'CONFLICTING', 'STALE', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')

event_timeline_to_valid.name: event_timeline_to_valid
event_timeline_to_valid.value: to_status IS NULL OR to_status IN ('UNVERIFIED', 'DEVELOPING', 'LIKELY', 'VERIFIED', 'CONFLICTING', 'STALE', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')

events_radius_range.name: events_radius_range
events_radius_range.value: affected_radius_m IS NULL OR affected_radius_m BETWEEN 1 AND 50000

events_schedule_order.name: events_schedule_order
events_schedule_order.value: scheduled_start_at IS NULL OR scheduled_end_at IS NULL OR scheduled_end_at >= scheduled_start_at

reports_label_len.name: reports_label_len
reports_label_len.value: location_label IS NULL OR char_length(location_label) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

reports_source_url_http.name: reports_source_url_http
reports_source_url_http.value: source_url IS NULL OR (char_length(source_url) <= 2048 AND source_url ~ '^https?://')

source_records_url_http.name: source_records_url_http
source_records_url_http.value: source_url IS NULL OR (char_length(source_url) <= 2048 AND source_url ~ '^https?://')

users_email_normalized.name: users_email_normalized
users_email_normalized.value: email = lower(email) AND char_length(email) BETWEEN 3 AND 254

verification_jobs_attempts_range.name: verification_jobs_attempts_range
verification_jobs_attempts_range.value: attempts >= 0 AND max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND attempts <= max_attempts
